rationale.consistency: Threads order explicitly like other per-adaptation state (options, warnings, groupCounter); the opt=="order" special case mirrors existing servers/log/default_bind cases, though it branches before optFunc instead of after.
rationale.edge_cases: Invalid order fails before any state is touched; multiple order lines in one block compound via existingVal; nil options map handled; plugin RegisterDirectiveOrder still splices into process-wide directiveOrder visible to all adaptations.
rationale.scope: Focused on the order state; maps.Clone of options and cloning directiveOrder go slightly beyond the minimum but are justified by the reuse/default-never-mutated requirements. No unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: Clear parameter threading and helpful doc comments; a few comments are long and one cites an issue URL, but nothing obscures the flow.
rationale.robustness: No shared mutable order state: directiveOrder is read-only during adaptation, parseOptOrder clones before mutating. newOrder.([]string) unchecked assertion is internal-only; no locks needed.
rationale.maintainability: Order is an explicit Helper field and parameter rather than a global, easy to follow; the string-keyed special case couples evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock to parseOptOrder and options["order"] is no longer populated, which future readers must know.
